b'# tinydl

A small command line downloader. It fetches a URL and writes the bytes to a file or to stdout, retrying failed requests (3 attempts, 20 s timeout).

## Usage

```
tinydl URL [-o OUTPUT] [-q]
```

## Command line options

### Positional arguments

- `url` \xe2\x80\x94 what to download

### Options

- `-o`, `--output` \xe2\x80\x94 file to write (default: stdout)
- `-q`, `--quiet` \xe2\x80\x94 no progress output
'
